notes: The exact mappings below follow the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador API header. The scenario resolves a valid adapter-supplied interaction class, successfully invokes each service while joined, then checks FederateNotExecutionMember with the same handle after resignation while the connection remains open.

requirements.statement: The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for publishInteractionClass. The test first successfully publishes an adapter-FOM-defined interaction class while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for unpublishInteractionClass. The test first successfully publishes and unpublishes a valid adapter-FOM-defined interaction class while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation with the same handle.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for subscribeInteractionClass. The test first successfully subscribes to a valid adapter-FOM-defined interaction class while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation with the same handle.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for unsubscribeInteractionClass. The test first successfully subscribes to and unsubscribes from a valid adapter-FOM-defined interaction class while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation with the same handle.
